title: Adaptive State-Triggered Optimization (gap-f4d9d89417)
falsifiable_statement: Under severe communication bandwidth caps (<= 64 bytes/sec) and lossy channel conditions, an adaptive state-triggered velocity threshold mechanism addressing gap-f4d9d89417 reduces total overhead by >= 40% while maintaining convergence within 10% of continuous broadcast baselines.
proposed_mechanism: State-dependent event-triggered consensus: nodes transmit positional and velocity state only when local trajectory divergence ||v_i(t) - v_i(t_last)|| exceeds adaptive threshold delta_v.
theoretical_rationale: In dense networks, steady-state coordination creates temporal correlation; broadcasting redundant or near-identical vectors wastes channel capacity without improving local neighborhood estimator accuracy.
